dedupe_keys.name: madagascar agricultural production and residue bioenergy inputs 2019

description: This database estimates agricultural residue resources from rice, maize and cassava production in Madagascar. Antananarivo technology and energy researchers combine national ministerial statistics with FAO comparisons, residue-to-crop ratios and utilisation assumptions. Mendeley version 3 provides five small CSV files covering agricultural biomass, estimated residues, available residues, ratios and utilisation factors, free under CC BY 4.0. The article identifies 2019 as the sole reference year, so geographic coverage is national and there is no time series for trend estimation. Other crops are excluded, and fixed ratios from international literature replace local residue measurements. These limitations prevent interpreting the estimates as assured collectable energy supply. Modellers could parameterise biomass-resource constraints in energy or agricultural-waste simulations. data-fabio-food-agriculture-biomass-input-output supplies a related international flow context at a different scale. No CSV values were downloaded and no energy-yield calculation or collection-cost estimate was reproduced.
